summary.en: Local inference router that spreads AI workloads across computers on the same network; the installer list includes an arm64 build.
summary.zh-TW: 本機推論路由器，可把 AI 工作負載分配到同一網路上的電腦；安裝程式清單包含 arm64 版本。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: Thurrott's report of NVIDIA's launch announcement lists PAIR as generally available alongside RTX Spark, but does not say the build was tested on RTX Spark hardware.
caveats.zh-TW: Thurrott 報導 NVIDIA 發表會時將 PAIR 列為正式推出，與 RTX Spark 並列，但未說明該版本曾在 RTX Spark 硬體上測試。
